commands.sentence: Check this repository against the conventions, every target but outbound: Writes nothing; refuses with exit 2 on an error finding and exit 1 on warnings alone.

next.when: to read the docs findings alone
once nothing is left to fix

commands.sentence: Lint the docs for change-narration, broken links, citations, and stray root markdown: Writes nothing; refuses a tree with a blocker finding.

next.when: when a citation finding names a stale baseline

commands.sentence: Show this repository's identity block and every surface held to it: Writes nothing; refuses a repository that records no identity block.

next.when: to see the correction for a drifted surface

commands.sentence: Judge one outbound text against the session-URL and tool-footer policy: Writes nothing; refuses a text carrying either with exit 1.
commands.no_next: a clean text is posted where it was written for; no abcd command follows it

commands.sentence: Gate the built website, rendering it first when absent: Writes only inside the output directory; refuses a site failing any gate with exit 1.

next.when: to render the website again after a fix
